name: The Horsemen

identity.note: The same group name stands on units of two 1997 wings, the IEWA and WWWF 1997 on Usenet. Nothing on this wing's pages ties the 2009 tag champions to either, and twelve years separate their dates, so the rows stay apart until a source says one is the other.

tenures.source: its home page as it stood about March 2009 (home-page-2009): named as the Tag-Team Champions, and in the headline 'Why?' as the group Blair Kivisto was saved from.

caption: The Tag Team Champions on the fed's about March 2009 home page, named in a headline as the group that threatened the Universal Champion at the close of Numbered Days; the page names no member.
